name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It regenerates detail in low-res frames without blurring edges, which directly boosts visual quality at minimal compute cost. The trade-off is extra setup time for ComfyUI integration, but the upscaler’s open-source license and lightweight footprint make it the fastest path to measurable gains.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because it targets resolution, not identity—faces still blur when the base model hallucinates features. RealVisXL’s face model risks overfitting to its synthetic training set, locking in uncanny valley artifacts; test it on 100 real faces first. The real alternative: swap in a face-specialized upscaler like GFPGAN 2.0 for the final pass—it trades compute for fidelity, and the artifact is measurable: PSNR >30 on LFW faces settles it.
